header.title: Agentic AI drives direct bookings, lowering hotel distribution and marketing costs

s01_bottom_line.text: Morgan Stanley estimates agentic AI could influence $55-85bn of hotel-industry spending, and that in 2025 hotel owners paid ~$40bn for distribution and ~$45bn for branding/marketing; larger hotel brands with loyalty programs could benefit from more direct bookings. ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩
The article suggests larger hotel brands could emerge as winners from agentic AI via stronger loyalty and direct bookings.

If AI agents route travelers directly to hotel websites, large branded hotel operators could see lower distribution/marketing costs and margin improvement, but the article does not quantify the earnings impact.
